caseNameFull: Crawford, Interim Field Office Director, Portland, Immigration and Customs Enforcement v. Suarez Martinez

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, case consolidated with No. 03-7434, Benitez v. Mata, Interim Field Office Director, Miami, Immigration and Customs Enforcement [certiorari granted, ante, p. 1147], and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.
